brief: Hikami, Notes on construction of the knot invariant from the quantum dilogarithm function (RIMS Kôkyûroku) — knot invariants built from Faddeev's quantum dilogarithm.
extended:
**Notes on Construction of the Knot Invariant from Quantum Dilogarithm Function** — Kazuhiro Hikami. RIMS Kôkyûroku proceedings.

Construction of knot invariants from the quantum dilogarithm, following the line from the Jones polynomial through the quantum-group invariants (HOMFLY, colored Jones, Kauffman) to the dilogarithmic ones.

**Why it may bear here.** The quantum dilogarithm is the object this corpus's Φ_q / Li₂^q material is written in, and Kashaev's original link invariant (kashaev1995) is the paper this one builds on.

**Extraction caveat.** The held scan is a RIMS volume with a broken text encoding — Japanese runs render as mojibake and TeX escapes appear literally, so the body is not reliably machine-readable and grep over its sections will miss things.

provenance.note: Written after reading the document. Preserved across regeneration. Any "why it may bear here" paragraph is a prior for attention, not a corpus claim — no result is asserted to be in use.
